rationale: The agent executed an order-changing action (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first confirming the details with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Authentication is not clearly satisfied beyond looking up the account by the provided email; no explicit verification step is shown. The agent also stated a specific $7.99 refund without visible supporting tool output. While the agent did use the specified order ID and gift card and described the correct exchange items, the lack of prior confirmation and unclear authentication mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
